jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Are you passionate about automation, intelligent workflows and improving industrial efficiency? A growing technology company is looking for an experienced Automation Engineer to build smarter automation solutions for industrial and business operations!
jobs.requirements:
Strong hands-on experience with RPA tools
Good programming & scripting knowledge
Excel-based data collection, processing & report automation
Design, develop, test & deploy automated workflows
Understanding of industrial & manufacturing environments
Knowledge of process optimization & operational efficiency
Manage automation projects from requirements to production
jobs.responsibilities:
Identify repetitive manual tasks & develop automation solutions
Design & implement automated business and operational workflows
Automate Excel-based reporting & data management
Test, troubleshoot & maintain automation workflows
Collaborate with teams to understand business requirements
Lead automation initiatives to improve productivity
